items.title: Charlie Hardy Interview, 1961-12-16
items.q: Sushan has on many occasions mentioned those two bands... Yes, we did.

ctx.x: Uh, I, I'm quite sure that the, uh, stories of, uh, those bands are fairly well known, and, uh, uh, Sushan has on many occasions mentioned those two bands. As, uh, uh, school, uh, school boys, you got into these clubs and, and danced to them or heard them?
